mapper.select: SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary ORDER BY dictionary_no DESC
SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary WHERE dictionary_no = #{dictionary_no}

SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary WHERE dictionary_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR dictionary_content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY dictionary_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_finance_dictionary SET dictionary_nm = #{dictionary_nm}, dictionary_category = #{dictionary_category}, dictionary_content = #{dictionary_content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE dictionary_no = #{dictionary_no}
mapper.select: SELECT DICTIONARY_NO, DICTIONARY_NM, DICTIONARY_CONTENT, DICTIONARY_CATEGORY, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_FINANCE_DICTIONARY WHERE ( #{searchType} = 'all' AND ( DICTIONARY_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DICTIONARY_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DICTIONARY_CATEGORY LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ) OR ( #{searchType} = 'name' AND DICTIONARY_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) OR ( #{searchType} = 'category' AND DICTIONARY_CATEGORY LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ORDER BY DICTIONARY_NO DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary WHERE INSTR(#{question}, dictionary_nm) > 0 OR dictionary_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(dictionary_content, #{keyword}) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN dictionary_nm = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN INSTR(#{question}, dictionary_nm) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN dictionary_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' THEN 3 WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(dictionary_content, #{keyword}) > 0 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, view_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary WHERE dictionary_category = #{category} AND dictionary_nm != #{category} ORDER BY dictionary_no ASC
